title: Larger font sizes and reading speed for children aged 7 to 9
statement:
Children aged 7 to 9 read and comprehend text up to 9% faster when it is presented in larger font sizes (e.g., 26pt / 5.0mm x-height) than standard early-reader defaults.

Options:
- Early Readers (Ages 7-9): 24px - 28px (High x-height) (fits: edtech platforms, childrens ebooks)
- Intermediate Readers (Ages 10-12): 18px - 22px (fits: middle school education, learning management)
- Adult Standard: 16px default (fits: general audience, parent dashboards)
- Child-friendly Typefaces: Verdana / Sassoon fonts (fits: primary education)
appliesWhen: Applies to: edtech, educational games, web. Audience: children under 10, parents.

source.title: Typography for children may be inappropriately designed
source.authors: Arnold Wilkins; Roanna Cleave; Nicola Grayson; Louise Wilson
